series.name: Find Yourself
series.text: A series centered on self-discovery and identity — a continuous journey marked by both challenges and quiet moments of reflection.

series.name: Illusion
series.text: A meditation on the eye — an emotional reservoir, a silent mirror of all that is felt yet rarely expressed.

series.name: Faces in Flux
series.text: The emotional state of being in between — in motion, not fixed. Presence isn't still; it flickers, fades, returns.

series.name: Hidden Tears
series.text: Her eyes are closed, but the feeling is loud. In this fractured stillness, tears fall inward — the quiet wars we fight inside.

series.name: Silenced
series.text: A quiet gesture — 'shhh' — yet the silence speaks louder than words. It questions the cost of being silenced.

series.name: Moments of Impermanence
series.text: A study of impermanence — millions of dots gather, thin out, and scatter in continuous change. Nothing stays; everything moves.

series.name: Wawes
series.text: Where water becomes sculpture, and time slows into breath — a cinematic meditation on flow, light, and presence.

series.name: Jellyfish
series.text: Like sculpture in motion — a meditative drift through fluid presence and emotional stillness, where time feels suspended.

series.name: Gaze Capsule
series.text: An eye suspended in a floating bubble — a visual metaphor for how presence transforms reality.

series.name: Unconscious Mind
series.text: A breathing, shifting field of emotion — expressions unfold and dissolve. A meditation on the impermanence of feeling.

series.name: Red
series.text: A tactile exploration of tension, memory, and material transformation — beauty shaped under pressure.

series.name: Black Series
series.text: A dense and immersive black surface formed from sculpted fabric and plaster, sealed in glossy epoxy.
